title: Name your layout with grid areas
why_it_matters: Named areas make a page layout readable like a drawing.
explanation: grid-template-areas lets you draw the layout in text. Each quoted row is a row of the grid, and each word is a cell name. Then assign elements to names with grid-area. Rearranging for mobile is just rewriting the drawing.
try_it: Sketch a page with header, nav, main and footer, then write the areas for it.
